en.headline: Last Huanggang shuttle leaves San Tin before Monday opening
en.dek: Transport officials said the final shuttle from San Tin is due between 6:15am and 6:20am on 12 October, with buses covering the rebuilt port.
body: The Transport Department said the last Huanggang shuttle from San Tin Public Transport Interchange to the existing port will leave between 6:15am and 6:20am on Monday, ahead of the rebuilt crossing's 6:30am opening.

Assistant Commissioner Ivy Tse Sin-yee said passengers who miss that departure can use three franchised bus routes — Kowloon Motor Bus B11, New Lantao Bus B12 and Citybus B13 — and three green-minibus routes, 44B, 44B1 and 78, from the interchange to the rebuilt Huanggang Port. Southbound, the last shuttle to San Tin will leave once people who entered the old port before 6:30am have cleared and boarded, she said.

Tse said signs and road markings had been put in place to direct drivers to the new port, and that police would guide vehicles on site. Vehicles, including public transport, that cannot reach the existing port before the handover will be held briefly in a public-transport buffer nearby and sent on after 6:30am, she said.

Boundary District Commander Lau King-lun said police would set up a command centre at Huanggang from midnight on 12 October to watch passenger and vehicle flows. He said officers would deploy from the early hours because of media arrangements and people who may come for the last services or to take photographs, and that crowd-control measures would be used.

zh.headline: 皇巴尾班周一6時15分開出 巴士接載往新皇崗
zh.dek: 運輸署稱新田開出的皇巴尾班在6時15至20分，趕不及的乘客可轉乘B11、B12、B13及三條專線小巴。
body: 重建後的皇崗口岸定於10月12日上午6時30分正式開通。運輸署助理署長謝善怡表示，現時皇崗口岸的皇巴尾班，將於當日上午6時15分至6時20分由新田公共運輸交匯處開出。
謝善怡說，未能趕上尾班皇巴的乘客，可在交匯處轉乘九巴B11、嶼巴B12、城巴B13，以及專線小巴44B、44B1和78號線，前往重建後的皇崗口岸過關。南行往新田交匯處的皇巴尾班，則視乎上午6時30分前進入內地方舊口岸的跨境人士完成清關及上車後開出。
她表示，署方已設置交通標誌和道路標記，指示駕駛者前往新口岸，警方亦會在現場指引。未能在交接前抵達現有口岸的車輛，包括相關公共運輸，會在附近公共交通緩衝區短暫停留，待6時30分啟用後直接前往新口岸。
警務處邊界區指揮官劉經倫說，警方由12日零時起在皇崗口岸設立指揮中心，實時監察人流及車流。因應傳媒採訪，以及可能有市民趕乘尾班或到舊口岸及新田交匯處拍照，警方會在清晨部署人手，實施人群管理。
